changelog:
brand-jingle-studio 0.1.1

- Initial release of Brand Jingle Studio, a tool to create original brand jingles, ad songs, and audio-logo stings for commercial use.
- Supports generating sung hooks, instrumental stings, or spoken taglines across various campaign destinations (ads, intros, store openings, etc.).
- Delivers three style sketches first; allows users to lock one, then derive other lengths and versions as needed.
- Includes clear routing for requests best served by adjacent skills (personal songs, video beds, playlists, covers, etc.).
- Ensures clear confirmation and billing steps before any paid music or voice synthesis work begins.
summary: Turn a brand name, slogan, and campaign use into a set of original brand jingles, ad songs, and audio-logo stings. This brand jingle maker and AI jingle generator drafts the hook and optional sung line, then generates reviewable tracks in the lengths and styles the campaign needs for ads, store openings, podcast intros, and radio spots. Use it as an ad song generator and brand music generator for brand theme songs, commercial jingles, advertising jingles, sonic logos, audio logo stings, campaign music, radio jingles, podcast intro jingles, and event walk-on themes, with each candidate generated as original music you can use commercially.
